data.name: Bedanta
data.gender_notes: Bedanta is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Beda - different, tantra - weaving. This name signifies one who weaves different aspects of knowledge and wisdom. The name Bedanta carries the meaning “Knowledge, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bedanta usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of spiritual and intellectual growth.
data.etymology: Bedanta belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bedanta total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
